messages:
Aisha Patel: FYI — we need a short, clear outbound to affected tenants for the onboarding indexing lag. Goal: explain status, ETA, mitigation steps, and offer a 1:1 coaching session.
Maria Gomez: I can draft. Keep it <3 paragraphs and include an easy opt-in for the coaching. :thumbsup: 
Josh Lee: Add a line about the temporary workaround (reindex retry) and that logs show a backlog processing window. Quick snippet: `If you see missing documents, trigger a manual reindex in Console > Indexes > Reindex`
Samir Khan: ETA on fix from eng? I heard a rolling deploy started at 12:10 PST.
csops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout-job-983 started at 2025-03-18T12:10:24Z, completing nodes: 6/12.
Maria Gomez: OK here's a draft — please edit: `Hi — We're seeing a processing backlog impacting new tenant indexes created between 11:30–12:30 PST. Our engineers have deployed a fix and are processing the backlog; we expect full catch-up within 3 hours. If you'd like immediate access to your indexed data, you can trigger a manual reindex in the Console (Console > Indexes > Reindex). We're sorry for the disruption — as a small token we'll offer a 7-day trial of our onboarding coaching session. Reply "coach" to opt in and we'll schedule.`
Aisha Patel: Nice. Add line: "No customer data was exposed or modified." and a note about credits: "We will add a one-time credit equal to one day of ingestion costs."
Jen O'Neill: Suggest changing "trial" -> "complimentary onboarding coaching session" and include link to calendar: https://cal.redwood.com/cs-onboard (short link OK). Also add contact: cs@redwood.ai for urgent issues.
Maria Gomez: Finalizing now. Will send at :bell: 12:20 PST after confirming deploy-bot reports full rollout. I'll post copy in Intercom and send targeted emails for enterprise accounts.
Josh Lee: After send, can we capture feedback? Add quick one-question survey link: "Was this communication helpful? (Yes / No)" and log responses to the tenant health doc.
Aisha Patel: Good call. Tagging owners: Maria will send the outbound, Jen will handle enterprise emails, Samir will verify credits applied, Josh will own feedback capture. :raised_hands: 
csops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout-job-983 update: completing nodes: 12/12, status: success at 2025-03-18T12:16:08Z.
Samir Khan: Confirmed — backlog processing rate increased after the fix, current projection: catch-up by 15:20 PST. I'll follow up to confirm credits posted and close the loop in this thread.
Aisha Patel: Perfect — please paste the final outbound copy and the Intercom campaign id here once sent. Closing thread after last send + feedback summary. Thanks everyone. :pray:
